verdict.rationale: Voice conversation is a fair axis for a personal assistant, but the evidence never documents real-time voice chat with jo. "jo speaks on macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, and email" describes messaging channels, not spoken audio. jo having "its own phone" is an adjacent capability, not a documented natural voice conversation between the user and the assistant.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
